rule_locator: Canticle of the Wing, Birdfolk traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Winged Birdfolk. Use the original gifts. The later Flightless and Mystic supplements and Humblewood birdfolk are separate rules.

rule_locator: Cervid traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Cervid / deerfolk. Keep the printed Fleet Feet and Regal Antlers options together.

rule_locator: Chrysalian base traits, Hovering, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Chrysalian / Chrysalians. Insectoid fey of the Dreaming. Distinct from Skathári and Keridani.

rule_locator: Constructed traits, frame gifts, and paragon upgrades
aliases_and_boundary: Constructed is the A5E name. Keep its Military, Service, and Utility frames together and other construct profiles separate.

rule_locator: Dreamborn traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Dreamborn of the Dreaming. Distinct from Grim Hollow Dreamer, Chrysalian, and similar fey options.

rule_locator: Dryadborn traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Dryadborn descends from dryads and mortals. Keep the PC1 Dryad and Mage Hand Press Mandrake separate.

rule_locator: Heritages of the Coral Climes, Galeoni traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Galeoni / shark-folk as a descriptive term. Keep Mystaran Shark-Kin and Pode separate.

rule_locator: Garoul traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Garoul / wolf-folk as a descriptive term. Keep Madrai, Lupin, and lycanthropy separate.

rule_locator: Madrai traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Madrai / dog-folk as a descriptive term. Keep Garoul and Mystaran Lupin separate.

rule_locator: Oxfolk traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Oxfolk / ox folk. Keep the bovine heritage separate from the bull-headed Minotaur.

rule_locator: Pantheran base traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Pantheran / Pantherans. Keep Snow-Spotted, Stripefolk, and Wildkin together. Tabaxi and Valna have separate profiles.

rule_locator: Heritages of the Coral Climes, Pode traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Pode / octopus-folk as a descriptive term. Keep Nautilid and Galeoni separate.

rule_locator: Shadowcast traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Shadowcast / shadow reflections. Use the A5E heritage and keep Shade and Shadow Fey separate.

rule_locator: Those of the Web, Spiderfolk traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Spiderfolk / spider folk. Keep Drider separate. Include the printed heritage gifts without creating separate profiles.

rule_locator: Zevite traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Zevite / Zevites. Use the A5E astral heritage. Keep Gith and other planefaring species separate.

rule_locator: Heritages, Motley traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Motley / Motleys. Keep the patchwork gift options in the same heritage and named animal ancestries separate.

rule_locator: Heritages, Mycelial traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Mycelial / Mycelials. Keep Myconid and other fungus-folk profiles separate.

rule_locator: Heritages, Oozefolk traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Oozefolk / ooze folk. Use the A5E gifts and keep Amoeboid and Plasmoid separate.

rule_locator: Heritages, Ratling traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Ratling / Ratlings. Keep Mousefolk and Ratatosk separate.

rule_locator: Heritages, Rockborn traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Rockborn uses the A5E stone-folk rules. Keep Houseki, Galeb Duhr, and earth elementals separate.

rule_locator: Chapter 1, Origins, Axon traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Axon / Axons. Furred alien heritage. Keep the Axon gifts together.

rule_locator: Chapter 1, Origins, Grey traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Grey / Greys. Gray is an alternate English spelling for search. Keep Kesh and other psionic species separate.

rule_locator: Chapter 1, Origins, Houseki traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Houseki. Use the Voidrunner crystalline heritage and keep Rockborn separate.

rule_locator: Chapter 1, Origins, Hurroc traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Hurroc / Hurrocs. Keep Voidrunner origin and adrenal traits together.

rule_locator: Chapter 1, Origins, Keridani traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Keridani. Use the Voidrunner psionic insectoid heritage. Keep Chrysalian and Skathári separate.

rule_locator: Chapter 1, Origins, Naato traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Naato. Use the Voidrunner reptilian heritage. Keep Matokai and Lizardfolk separate.

rule_locator: Chapter 1, Origins, Sipher traits, gifts, and paragon
aliases_and_boundary: Sipher / Siphers. Keep the colony and planet-linked gift choices under one heritage.

rule_locator: p. 9 onward, Aboleth Traits
aliases_and_boundary: Aboleth / Aboleths. Use the player-scale traits and keep any campaign aboleth and encounter stat blocks separate.

rule_locator: pp. 11–14, Animated Objects player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Animated Object / Animated Objects. Animated Armor, Flying Sword, and Rug of Smothering share one claim.

rule_locator: p. 14 onward, Ankheg player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Ankheg / Ankhegs. Use the printed player burrower and keep other insectoid heritages separate.

rule_locator: p. 17 onward, Banshee player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Banshee / Banshees. Distinct from Banshrae and other undead player profiles.

rule_locator: p. 18 onward, Basilisk player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Basilisk / Basilisks. Use Kamstra's player creature. Keep the Cockatrice separate.

rule_locator: p. 20 onward, Behir player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Behir / Behirs. Keep distinct from dragons and the source's unconverted encounter monster.

rule_locator: pp. 21–23, shared Beholder traits and printed subraces
aliases_and_boundary: Beholder / Beholders. Keep Eye Tyrant, Death Tyrant, and Spectator under one profile.

rule_locator: pp. 23–25, shared Blight traits and printed subraces
aliases_and_boundary: Blight / Blights. Keep Needle, Twig, and Vine Blight together. Other plant heritages retain their own scopes.

rule_locator: p. 26 onward, Bulette player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Bulette / land shark. Keep the terrestrial burrower separate from aquatic shark-folk.

rule_locator: p. 28 onward, Cambion player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Cambion / Cambions. Keep this option separate from Tiefling and the supplement's other fiends.

rule_locator: p. 29 onward, Carrion Crawler player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Carrion Crawler / Carrion Crawlers. Use the printed player version and its manipulation limits.

rule_locator: p. 31 onward, Chimera player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Chimera / Chimeras. Keep the printed heads and breath choices together.

rule_locator: p. 32 onward, Chuul player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Chuul / Chuuls. Keep Aboleth and other crustacean-like options separate.

rule_locator: p. 33 onward, Cloaker player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Cloaker / Cloakers. Darkmantle remains a separate profile.

rule_locator: p. 34 onward, Cockatrice player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Cockatrice / Cockatrices. Keep separate from Basilisk and Birdfolk.

rule_locator: p. 35 onward, Couatl player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Couatl / Couatls. Use the player version of the feathered serpent, separate from Flying Snake and Yuan-ti.

rule_locator: p. 36 onward, Crawling Claw player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Crawling Claw / Crawling Claws. Apply the supplement's Tiny creature rules where appropriate.

rule_locator: p. 37 onward, Cyclops player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Cyclops / Cyclopes. Keep this distinct from other giant profiles.

rule_locator: p. 38 onward, Darkmantle player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Darkmantle / Darkmantles. Keep Cloaker separate.

rule_locator: pp. 41–42, Demilich Traits
aliases_and_boundary: Demilich / Demiliches. Keep the phylactery rules here, and the separate Lich template outside this claim.

rule_locator: p. 64 onward, Displacer Beast player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Displacer Beast / Displacer Beasts. Use the printed player conversion and its item limitations.

rule_locator: p. 71 onward, Dragon Turtle player traits
aliases_and_boundary: Dragon Turtle / Dragon Turtles. Keep it separate from Dragonborn and true-dragon player packages.

rule_locator: pp. 141–142, Mimic Traits
aliases_and_boundary: Mimic / Mimics. Keep its object form in the same profile and Animated Object separate.
